02 / CONTROLS

Driving rehearsal

NO MOTORS
Driving guide & limits

Enable, then hold a direction. Releasing it ends the rehearsal. The car turns in arcs, not on the spot.

A screen Stop is not a physical emergency stop. Closing the page or releasing a button cannot guarantee stopping after a computer/controller/link failure. Use physical power-off if abnormal; do not lift a moving robot.

Keyboard drivingHOLD · RELEASE TO STOP
A LEFTD RIGHT

Ramp request 0.000 m/s0.30 m/s ceiling · 5 s S-curve · not measured speed

Key behaviour

W/S accelerate forward/reverse from rest. Press the opposite key while travelling to decelerate; both keys brake, not cruise. At zero, release and press afresh to reverse. B requests immediate zero. Release all travel to stop. Steering does not reduce the speed request.

When checked, healthy and stationary, a fresh travel press can enable without a separate click. A held key never resumes after a fault. Stop/Space/Escape locks this shortcut until explicit Enable or untick/re-tick. Keyboards do not measure pressure.

Throttle 0% · steering 0%

Requested travel · not measured0.000 m/s
Maximum travel request—
Keyboard steering

W/S: travel. A/D: full left/right steering while held; release centres steering. A+D centres too. Steering alone never moves the robot. Press steering afresh after enabling or a fault; held keys do not replay. Mouse steering is disconnected. Touch steering remains an unverified coarse-pointer fallback. No lateral movement or in-place spinning.
